title: USDC on Arc testnet
tagline: Every USDC transfer on Arc, indexed live by one Rust binary and queryable with plain SQL or from your AI agent.

queries.title: Latest transfers
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, "from", "to", value_dec FROM usdc__transfer ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Top 10 senders, last 24h
queries.sql: SELECT "from", sum(value_dec) AS total_base_units, count(*) AS transfers FROM usdc__transfer WHERE block_timestamp > extract(epoch from now()) - 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_base_units DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Transfers per hour, last 24h
queries.sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(block_timestamp)) AS hour, count(*) AS transfers FROM usdc__transfer WHERE block_timestamp > extract(epoch from now()) - 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

queries.title: Mints and burns
queries.sql: SELECT 'mint' AS kind, count(*) AS n, sum(amount_dec) AS base_units FROM usdc__mint UNION ALL SELECT 'burn', count(*), sum(amount_dec) FROM usdc__burn

queries.title: Busiest receivers, all time
queries.sql: SELECT "to", count(*) AS transfers FROM usdc__transfer GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY transfers DESC LIMIT 10

prompts: Who were the 10 largest USDC senders in the last 24 hours on this nest? Show amounts in USDC (6 decimals).
How many USDC transfers happened per hour over the last 12 hours, and which hour was the busiest?
What is the latest block this nest has indexed, and what is the UTC timestamp of the newest USDC transfer?
Find the single largest USDC transfer ever indexed here and tell me who sent it, who received it and when.
List every table in this nest with its row count, then explain in two sentences what the data is good for.
